description: Spends credits: the contacts price from get_nyc_property (usually 3 credits). Takes only the lot's BBL, including a condo unit's BBL from get_nyc_unit; for a unit whose report is locked it first unlocks the unit report (its report price, usually 1 credit), so quote both. Returns how to reach the owner of record of that lot about the property: the owner's name, phone numbers (with line type and do-not-call flag) and email addresses. When the owner of record is a company, the contact is the company's principal. Needs the full report unlocked first (unlock_nyc_property_report). Free if already unlocked for this workspace. Tell the user the cost and get their go-ahead before calling.

bbl.description: The 10-digit NYC borough-block-lot id, e.g. "1000300034". Get it from find_nyc_property.
